args.result:
# AETHERION HEALTHCARE PLATFORM — COMPLETE FRONTEND ANALYSIS

## 1. PROJECT OVERVIEW
**Name:** Aetherion Health (v2.0.0)
**Description:** AI-Powered Healthcare Platform with real-time diagnostics, telemedicine, and smart pharmacy
**Author:** Pollob Das
**Stack:** React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Redux Toolkit + Tailwind CSS + Firebase (planned)
**Deployment:** PWA-ready with VitePWA plugin
**Routing:** react-router-dom v6 (lazy-loaded routes)
**Form Handling:** react-hook-form + zod (@hookform/resolvers)
**UI:** Radix UI (Dialog, Dropdown, Select, Tabs, Toast, Tooltip) + Framer Motion + Lucide Icons + Recharts + react-big-calendar
**Real-time:** socket.io-client
**State:** Redux Toolkit + redux-persist

## 2. PACKAGES/SCRIPTS
- `dev` / `start`: `vite --host` (port 3000)
- `build`: `tsc && vite build`
- Format/lint with prettier + eslint

## 3. REDUX STORE (9 Slices — src/store/index.ts)
Store config: `combineReducers` with `redux-persist` (whitelist: client, doctor, hospital, appointment, emergency, pharmacy, admin, ui; auth is BLACKLISTED — no persistence)

### 3.1 authSlice (src/store/slices/authSlice.ts)
**State:**
```ts
AuthState {
  user: User | null;
  isAuthenticated: boolean;
  isLoading: boolean;
  error: string | null;
}
```
**User Shape (multi-role):**
```ts
User {
  id: string; name?: string; fullName?: string; email: string; phone?: string;
  bloodGroup?: string; gender?: 'male' | 'female' | 'other'; profileImage?: string;
  role?: AccountRole; roles: AccountRole[]; primaryRole: AccountRole;
  upgrades: ProfileUpgrade[]; isVerified?: boolean; isAdminApproved?: boolean;
  isActive?: boolean; isOnline?: boolean; createdAt: string; updatedAt?: string; lastLogin?: string;
}
```
**AccountRole types:** 'normal_user' | 'client' | 'doctor' | 'hospital' | 'hospital_admin' | 'hospital_authority' | 'pharmacy' | 'pharmacy_admin' | 'admin' | 'admin_applicant' | 'blood_donor' | 'emergency_volunteer'
**ProfileUpgrade types:** 'client_patient' | 'blood_donor' | 'pharmacy_user' | 'emergency_volunteer'
**Actions:** login, logout, updateProfile, addRole, removeRole, setPrimaryRole, addUpgrade, removeUpgrade, switchRole, setOnlineStatus, clearError, setLoading + async thunks (loginUser, registerUser, logoutUser)

### 3.2 clientSlice (src/store/slices/clientSlice.ts)
**State:** profile (ClientProfile), appointments, bloodDonations, recommendations, reminders (MedicineReminder), emergencyRequests, prescriptions, reports, timeline (HealthTimelineEvent), stats (HealthStats), isLoading
**ClientProfile fields:** id, userId, fullName, email, phone, dateOfBirth, gender, bloodGroup, address, avatar, emergencyContact, medicalHistory, vaccines, allergies, chronicDiseases
**MedicalHistory:** conditions[], surgeries[], medications[], reports[]
**HealthStats:** upcomingAppointments, activePrescriptions, bloodDonations, medicalReports, nextDonationDate, lastCheckup, healthScore

### 3.3 doctorSlice/DoctorSlice (src/store/slices/DoctorSlice.ts)
**State:** profile (DoctorProfile), appointments, patients, prescriptions, emergencies, videoConsultations, earnings, schedule, reports, stats, isLoading, error
**DoctorProfile:** id, name, email, phone, specialization, licenseNumber, experience, qualifications[], consultationFee, isOnline, etc.
**DoctorStats:** totalPatients, todayAppointments, completedToday, pendingEmergencies, videoConsultations, earningsToday, onlineStatus, totalPrescriptions, averageConsultationTime

### 3.4 hospitalSlice (src/store/slices/hospitalSlice.ts)
**State:** profile (HospitalProfile), bedInfo (BedInfo[]), bloodStock (BloodStock[]), stats (HospitalStats), doctors[], departments[], isLoading, error
**HospitalProfile:** id, name, registrationNumber, type, phone, emergencyPhone, email, address, totalBeds, availableBeds, icuTotalBeds, icuAvailableBeds, emergencyServiceStatus, ambulanceCount, ambulanceAvailable, rating, isVerified
**BedInfo:** id, hospitalId, type ('general'|'icu'|'emergency'|'pediatric'|'maternity'), total, available, occupied, costPerDay
**HospitalStats:** todayPatients, newAdmissions, discharges, emergencies, surgeries, occupancyRate

### 3.5 appointmentSlice (src/store/slices/appointmentSlice.ts)
**State:** appointments[], selectedAppointment, isLoading, error, filters {status, type, date, search}, stats {total, scheduled, completed, cancelled, todayCount}, pagination {page, limit, total}
**Appointment (local):** id, patientId, patientName, doctorId, doctorName, doctorSpecialty, hospitalName, date, time, type, status, reason, notes, prescriptionId, followUpDate, amount, paymentStatus, createdAt, updatedAt
**Async thunks:** fetchAppointments, bookAppointment, cancelAppointment, rescheduleAppointment

### 3.6 emergencySlice (src/store/slices/emergencySlice.ts)
**State:** requests[], activeRequest, nearbyHospitals[], availableAmbulances[], isLoading, isSubmitting, error, sosActivated, stats {total, active, completed, avgResponseTime, todayCount}
**EmergencyRequest:** id, patientId, patientName, patientPhone, emergencyType (cardiac|accident|stroke|breathing|bleeding|allergy|pregnancy|other), description, severity (critical|high|medium|low), location, status (pending|dispatched|en-route|arrived|picked-up|at-hospital|completed|cancelled), ambulanceId, ambulance, hospitalId, hospital, assignedDoctor, vitalSigns, timeline[], createdAt
**Async thunks:** sendEmergencySOS, fetchNearbyHospitals, fetchAvailableAmbulances, cancelEmergency, updateEmergencyStatus

### 3.7 pharmacySlice (src/store/slices/pharmacySlice.ts)

# AETHERION HEALTHCARE PLATFORM — COMPLETE FRONTEND ANALYSIS

## 1. PROJECT OVERVIEW
**Name:** Aetherion Health (v2.0.0)
**Description:** AI-Powered Healthcare Platform with real-time diagnostics, telemedicine, and smart pharmacy
**Author:** Pollob Das
**Stack:** React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Redux Toolkit + Tailwind CSS + Firebase (planned)
**Deployment:** PWA-ready with VitePWA plugin
**Routing:** react-router-dom v6 (lazy-loaded routes)
**Form Handling:** react-hook-form + zod (@hookform/resolvers)
**UI:** Radix UI (Dialog, Dropdown, Select, Tabs, Toast, Tooltip) + Framer Motion + Lucide Icons + Recharts + react-big-calendar
**Real-time:** socket.io-client
**State:** Redux Toolkit + redux-persist

## 2. PACKAGES/SCRIPTS
- `dev` / `start`: `vite --host` (port 3000)
- `build`: `tsc && vite build`
- Format/lint with prettier + eslint

## 3. REDUX STORE (9 Slices — src/store/index.ts)
Store config: `combineReducers` with `redux-persist` (whitelist: client, doctor, hospital, appointment, emergency, pharmacy, admin, ui; auth is BLACKLISTED — no persistence)

### 3.1 authSlice (src/store/slices/authSlice.ts)
**State:**
```ts
AuthState {
  user: User | null;
  isAuthenticated: boolean;
  isLoading: boolean;
  error: string | null;
}
```
**User Shape (multi-role):**
```ts
User {
  id: string; name?: string; fullName?: string; email: string; phone?: string;
  bloodGroup?: string; gender?: 'male' | 'female' | 'other'; profileImage?: string;
  role?: AccountRole; roles: AccountRole[]; primaryRole: AccountRole;
  upgrades: ProfileUpgrade[]; isVerified?: boolean; isAdminApproved?: boolean;
  isActive?: boolean; isOnline?: boolean; createdAt: string; updatedAt?: string; lastLogin?: string;
}
```
**AccountRole types:** 'normal_user' | 'client' | 'doctor' | 'hospital' | 'hospital_admin' | 'hospital_authority' | 'pharmacy' | 'pharmacy_admin' | 'admin' | 'admin_applicant' | 'blood_donor' | 'emergency_volunteer'
**ProfileUpgrade types:** 'client_patient' | 'blood_donor' | 'pharmacy_user' | 'emergency_volunteer'
**Actions:** login, logout, updateProfile, addRole, removeRole, setPrimaryRole, addUpgrade, removeUpgrade, switchRole, setOnlineStatus, clearError, setLoading + async thunks (loginUser, registerUser, logoutUser)

### 3.2 clientSlice (src/store/slices/clientSlice.ts)
**State:** profile (ClientProfile), appointments, bloodDonations, recommendations, reminders (MedicineReminder), emergencyRequests, prescriptions, reports, timeline (HealthTimelineEvent), stats (HealthStats), isLoading
**ClientProfile fields:** id, userId, fullName, email, phone, dateOfBirth, gender, bloodGroup, address, avatar, emergencyContact, medicalHistory, vaccines, allergies, chronicDiseases
**MedicalHistory:** conditions[], surgeries[], medications[], reports[]
**HealthStats:** upcomingAppointments, activePrescriptions, bloodDonations, medicalReports, nextDonationDate, lastCheckup, healthScore

### 3.3 doctorSlice/DoctorSlice (src/store/slices/DoctorSlice.ts)
**State:** profile (DoctorProfile), appointments, patients, prescriptions, emergencies, videoConsultations, earnings, schedule, reports, stats, isLoading, error
**DoctorProfile:** id, name, email, phone, specialization, licenseNumber, experience, qualifications[], consultationFee, isOnline, etc.
**DoctorStats:** totalPatients, todayAppointments, completedToday, pendingEmergencies, videoConsultations, earningsToday, onlineStatus, totalPrescriptions, averageConsultationTime

### 3.4 hospitalSlice (src/store/slices/hospitalSlice.ts)
**State:** profile (HospitalProfile), bedInfo (BedInfo[]), bloodStock (BloodStock[]), stats (HospitalStats), doctors[], departments[], isLoading, error
**HospitalProfile:** id, name, registrationNumber, type, phone, emergencyPhone, email, address, totalBeds, availableBeds, icuTotalBeds, icuAvailableBeds, emergencyServiceStatus, ambulanceCount, ambulanceAvailable, rating, isVerified
**BedInfo:** id, hospitalId, type ('general'|'icu'|'emergency'|'pediatric'|'maternity'), total, available, occupied, costPerDay
**HospitalStats:** todayPatients, newAdmissions, discharges, emergencies, surgeries, occupancyRate

### 3.5 appointmentSlice (src/store/slices/appointmentSlice.ts)
**State:** appointments[], selectedAppointment, isLoading, error, filters {status, type, date, search}, stats {total, scheduled, completed, cancelled, todayCount}, pagination {page, limit, total}
**Appointment (local):** id, patientId, patientName, doctorId, doctorName, doctorSpecialty, hospitalName, date, time, type, status, reason, notes, prescriptionId, followUpDate, amount, paymentStatus, createdAt, updatedAt
**Async thunks:** fetchAppointments, bookAppointment, cancelAppointment, rescheduleAppointment

### 3.6 emergencySlice (src/store/slices/emergencySlice.ts)
**State:** requests[], activeRequest, nearbyHospitals[], availableAmbulances[], isLoading, isSubmitting, error, sosActivated, stats {total, active, completed, avgResponseTime, todayCount}
**EmergencyRequest:** id, patientId, patientName, patientPhone, emergencyType (cardiac|accident|stroke|breathing|bleeding|allergy|pregnancy|other), description, severity (critical|high|medium|low), location, status (pending|dispatched|en-route|arrived|picked-up|at-hospital|completed|cancelled), ambulanceId, ambulance, hospitalId, hospital, assignedDoctor, vitalSigns, timeline[], createdAt
**Async thunks:** sendEmergencySOS, fetchNearbyHospitals, fetchAvailableAmbulances, cancelEmergency, updateEmergencyStatus

### 3.7 pharmacySlice (src/store/slices/pharmacySlice.ts)
**State:** profile (PharmacyProfile), medicines[], orders[], stockAlerts[], totalOrders, totalRevenue, todayOrders, todayRevenue, isLoading, error
**PharmacyProfile:** id, name, registrationNumber, licenseNumber, phone, email, address, isVerified, isOpen, is24x7, deliveryAvailable, rating, reviewCount
**Medicine:** id, name, genericName, category, type, stock, minStock, price, expiryDate, manufacturer, isAvailable

### 3.8 adminSlice (src/store/slices/adminSlice.ts)
**State:** currentAdmin (AdminUser), stats (SystemStats), pendingVerifications, allUsers, isLoading, error
**AdminUser:** id, name, email, role (super-admin|admin|moderator|support), permissions[], lastLogin, isActive
**SystemStats:** totalUsers, totalDoctors, totalHospitals, totalPharmacies, totalBloodDonors, activeUsers, newUsersToday, blockedUsers

### 3.9 uiSlice (src/store/slices/uiSlice.ts)
**State:** darkMode (boolean), sidebarExpanded, sidebarOpen, notifications (number), language, fontSize ('small'|'medium'|'large')

## 4. ALL TYPES/INTERFACES (src/types/)

### 4.1 user.ts / auth.ts
- **UserRole:** 'patient' | 'doctor' | 'admin' | 'staff'
- **Gender:** 'male' | 'female' | 'other' | 'prefer-not-to-say'
- **User:** id, email, phone, name, firstName?, lastName?, role, gender?, avatar?, dateOfBirth?, address?, isVerified, isActive, createdAt, updatedAt
- **Patient extends User:** bloodGroup, height, weight, allergies[], chronicConditions[], medications[], emergencyContacts[], insuranceProvider?, insurancePolicyNumber?

- **LoginCredentials:** email, password
- **RegisterData:** name, email, phone, password, role

- **Doctor (FULL):** id, email, password?, firstName, lastName, fullName, phone, dateOfBirth, gender, specialization, subSpecializations[], qualifications[], experience, licenseNumber, medicalCouncil, hospitalName, hospitalAddress, department, designation, consultationFee, followUpFee, videoConsultationFee, consultationDuration, languages[], consultationModes[] ('in-person'|'video'|'phone'), availabilitySchedule (WeeklySchedule), isOnline, isAvailable, maxPatientsPerDay, rating, reviewCount, totalPatients, totalConsultations, successRate, experience_years, about, profileImage, coverImage, achievements[], awards[], publications[], memberships[], emailVerified, phoneVerified, isActive, joinedDate, notificationsEnabled, smsAlertsEnabled, emailAlertsEnabled, address, education[], status ('online'|'offline'|'busy')

functionDeclarations.name: glob
functionDeclarations.description: Efficiently finds files matching specific glob patterns (e.g., `src/**/*.ts`, `**/*.md`), returning absolute paths sorted by modification time (newest first). Ideal for quickly locating files based on their name or path structure, especially in large codebases.

pattern.description: The glob pattern to match against (e.g., '**/*.py', 'docs/*.md').

path.description: Optional: The absolute path to the directory to search within. If omitted, searches the root directory.

case_sensitive.description: Optional: Whether the search should be case-sensitive. Defaults to false.

respect_git_ignore.description: Optional: Whether to respect .gitignore patterns when finding files. Only available in git repositories. Defaults to true.

maxResults.description: Optional: Maximum number of file paths to return (default: 1000). Use to limit output for broad patterns.

functionDeclarations.name: list_directory
functionDeclarations.description: Lists the names of files and subdirectories directly within a specified directory path. Can optionally ignore entries matching provided glob patterns.

path.description: The absolute path to the directory to list (must be absolute, not relative)

ignore.description: List of glob patterns to ignore

file_filtering_options.description: Optional: Whether to respect ignore patterns from .gitignore or .geminiignore

respect_git_ignore.description: Optional: Whether to respect .gitignore patterns when listing files. Only available in git repositories. Defaults to true.

respect_gemini_ignore.description: Optional: Whether to respect .geminiignore patterns when listing files. Defaults to true.

functionDeclarations.name: read_file
functionDeclarations.description: Reads and returns the content of a specified file. By default reads up to 2000 lines starting from the beginning of the file. Files whose selected range exceeds 256 KB are truncated with an advisory; use 'offset' and 'limit' only if the file is too large to read at once — it's recommended to read the whole file by not providing these parameters. Handles text, images (PNG, JPG, GIF, WEBP, SVG, BMP), and PDF files. For images, videos or other multimedia files, use the 'analyze_multimedia' tool if available.

absolute_path.description: The absolute path to the file to read (e.g., '/home/user/project/file.txt'). Relative paths are not supported. You must provide an absolute path.

offset.description: Optional: For text files, the 0-based line number to start reading from. Only provide if the file is too large to read at once.

limit.description: Optional: For text files, the maximum number of lines to read. Only provide if the file is too large to read at once.

functionDeclarations.name: run_shell_command
functionDeclarations.description:
This tool executes a given shell command using the best available Windows shell (PowerShell Core, Windows PowerShell, or Command Prompt).

IMPORTANT:
- This tool is for terminal operations (e.g., git / npm / docker / build & test commands).
- DO NOT use this tool for file operations like reading, writing, editing, or searching files. Prefer the dedicated file tools for those actions.
- Quote any file path that contains spaces with double quotes, e.g. `cd "/path with spaces"` or `python "/path with spaces/script.py"`.
- If a command would produce very large output, prefer adding flags/filters (narrow paths, limit counts, request specific fields, machine-readable formats like JSON) to keep output small and unambiguous.
- Very large outputs may be returned as the most recent tail of the output. Earlier content may be truncated from the beginning. If the tool reports a "Full output saved to: <path>", that file contains the full command output. Use the exact path returned by the tool, then prefer searching that file first (grep/rg or platform equivalents) for specific ERROR/WARN/FAIL/SUCCESS markers, then reading small slices (with `read_file` using `offset`/`limit`) or tailing the log file instead of re-running expensive commands.
- Do not append truncating pipelines such as `| tail`, `| Select-Object -Last`, or similar to an expensive first run just to suppress output. Those discard earlier context and force a re-run if you later need omitted lines. Let the tool/log capture the full output, then inspect the saved log file.
- When issuing multiple shell commands in one response, parallelize only when they are truly independent and do not compete for the same files, directories, logs, locks, caches, git state, or ports. If one command depends on another or shared state may race, run them sequentially.

The following information is returned:
- Command: Executed command.
- Directory: Directory where command was executed, or `(root)`.
- Output: Combined command output (stdout/stderr). Can be `(empty)` or an excerpt if very large.
- Error: Error or `(none)` if no error was reported for the subprocess.
- Exit Code: Exit code or `(none)` if terminated by signal.
- Signal: Signal number or `(none)` if no signal was received.

command.description: Exact command to execute using the best available Windows shell (automatically selected from PowerShell Core, Windows PowerShell, or Command Prompt). Quote any file paths containing spaces with double quotes.

description.description: Brief description of the command for the user. Be specific and concise. Ideally a single sentence. Can be up to 3 sentences for clarity. No line breaks.

directory.description: (OPTIONAL) The absolute path of the directory to run the command in. If not provided, the project root directory is used. Must be a directory within the workspace and must already exist.

run_in_background.description: Set to true to run this command in the background. Returns immediately with task metadata and an output file path.

functionDeclarations.name: search_file_content
functionDeclarations.description: Searches for a regular expression pattern within the content of files in a specified directory, a specific file, or the current working directory. Can filter files by a glob pattern when searching directories. Returns the lines containing matches, along with their file paths and line numbers.

pattern.description: The regular expression (regex) pattern to search for within file contents (e.g., 'function\s+myFunction', 'import\s+\{.*\}\s+from\s+.*').

path.description: Optional: The absolute path to a directory or file to search within. If a file path is provided, searches only within that file. If a directory path is provided, searches all files in that directory. If omitted, searches the current working directory.

include.description: Optional: A glob pattern to filter which files are searched (e.g., '*.js', '*.{ts,tsx}', 'src/**'). Only applicable when searching directories, ignored for file searches. If omitted, searches all files (respecting potential global ignores).

maxResults.description: Optional: Maximum number of matches to return to prevent context overflow (default: 20, max: 150). Values above 150 are clamped automatically. Use lower values for broad searches, higher for specific searches.
